title: certified-biosensor-bounds: solver and study scripts for 'Certified-Bound Design of Capacitive and Conductimetric Lab-on-Chip Biosensors'
description: Dual transmission-line-matrix / finite-volume solver with guaranteed two-sided bounds (Prager-Synge), verification suite (16 tests) and the nine study scripts that produce every figure and table of the paper: H. Talleb, 'Certified-Bound Design of Capacitive and Conductimetric Lab-on-Chip Biosensors: Guaranteed Geometric Factors, Detection Windows and Electrode Rankings', IEEE Sensors Journal, 2026, doi:10.1109/JSEN.2026.3726458.

creators.name: Talleb, Hakeim
creators.affiliation: Sorbonne Universite, Universite Paris-Saclay, CNRS, CentraleSupelec, Laboratoire de Genie Electrique et Electronique de Paris (GeePs), France
